title: GTA VI: What Rockstar Actually Confirmed - and What It Did Not

blocks.text: ReMediaLHQ separates published evidence from interpretation before either reaches a script. Each material claim receives a visible state so an observation or hypothesis cannot silently become a confirmed fact.
This desk starts with one line in the ground: every GTA VI claim gets a state. Confirmed. Observed. Reported. Inferred.
Rockstar lists November 19, 2026 as the scheduled launch date. Rockstar currently lists PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S as launch platforms.
Rockstar places GTA VI in Vice City and across Leonida. Rockstar’s official story material centers Jason and Lucia.
Rockstar currently describes GTA VI as a single-player experience. Rockstar opened GTA VI pre-orders globally on June 25, 2026. Rockstar currently lists Standard and Ultimate editions of GTA VI.
Rockstar says GTA VI pre-loading begins at local midnight on November 12, 2026. Rockstar says the physical GTA VI box contains a download code rather than a disc.

Rockstar says the Extended Look was captured entirely from in-game footage on PlayStation 5. Rockstar staged the Extended Look on Netflix before publishing it to its official YouTube channel and GTA VI site later that day.
A current source state is not a promise that marketing material can never change. When authoritative information changes, the record changes without erasing its prior state.
Observed is different from confirmed. An official presentation may visibly depict behavior without explaining the system behind it or promising final shipping behavior.
The official presentation shows contextual interaction prompts; final shipping behavior is not yet confirmed.
The presentation depicts cover, combat, and weapon-pickup interactions; final implementation remains unconfirmed.
Reported means an accountable third party owns the claim. Inferred means the desk is connecting evidence into a hypothesis. Both can be useful when their state stays visible.
This desk does not publish or reproduce pre-release leaked footage. Public availability is not treated as commercial-use permission.
That boundary forces a stronger creative system: original diagrams, timelines, claim cards, structured dossiers, technical explanations, searchable answers, and visible corrections.
Every public item resolves to claim IDs. A claim has sources, a state, a confidence boundary, related entities, and a history.
August 29 is 82 calendar days before the currently scheduled November 19 launch.
A connected vidIQ snapshot dated August 28 estimated about 21 million monthly searches for ‘GTA 6’; this is a provider estimate, not an audited Google total.
No fake certainty. No invisible corrections. No dependence on stolen material. Subscribe for the state changes, not the recycled hype. Before the hype becomes history, we build the record.
